case_title: BINI, NICOLO G VS KOSICH, WALTER R

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $7,500.00 FILED BY BINI, NICOLO G AS TO DEFENDANT KOSICH, WALTER R ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-16-2007 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BINI, NICOLO G IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT KOSICH, WALTER R DEFENDANT APPEARED PERSONALLY, AND ACKNOWLEDGED SERVICE OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. PLAINTIFF WAS UNABLE TO ESTABLISH BY A PREPONDERANCE OF THE EVIDENCE THAT THE DEFENDANT CAUSED THE DAMAGE TO PLAINTIFF'S ARTWORK. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
